guard_mutation.mutation: one trailing line feed added to a temporary manifest copy

audit_surface.sample: Joint complete cases over y and requested x; unused columns do not affect the sample; row order is preserved and hashed.
audit_surface.design: Requested x order is preserved; _cons is appended last only when is_con is true; exact rank deficiency is rejected.
audit_surface.objective: Scaled rank-revealing least squares minimizes (y-Xb)'(y-Xb); beta is mapped back to original units.
audit_surface.derivatives: Independent gradient is -2X'(y-Xb), Hessian is 2X'X, and the frozen normal-equation residuals are near machine precision.
audit_surface.covariance: Only homoskedastic s2(X'X)^-1 is supported, with s2=RSS/(N-k); the SVD row-norm implementation matches the independent oracle.
audit_surface.degrees_of_freedom: df_model=k-c and df_resid=N-k; no-constant TSS, adjusted R-squared, F, and Total df use c=0 conventions.
audit_surface.probabilities: Two-sided t and right-tail F probabilities use SciPy survival functions and preserve representable nonzero tails.
audit_surface.failure_modes: Empty complete samples, N<=k, non-finite inputs, rank deficiency, and non-finite numerical paths fail explicitly; exact-fit inference is represented as undefined rather than false zero probability.
audit_surface.provenance: Each normalized engine result carries the frozen cases hash, seed, ordered included-row hash, and omitted-parameter list; comparison rejects disagreement before metric comparison.

tests.preflight_command: uv run python -m tabra.validation preflight --manifest validation/commands/reg/manifest.yaml
tests.relevant_command: uv run pytest -q -o addopts='' tests/test_ols.py tests/test_estimate_base_stats.py tests/test_ols_result.py tests/test_api.py tests/ops/test_stats.py tests/test_reg_validation_oracle.py tests/test_reg_runner_common.py tests/test_validation_core.py
tests.skip_disposition: All 52 skips belong to other estimator modules; none is a required reg check and none was counted as passing evidence.
tests.warning_disposition: All six warnings are plotting-backend or Matplotlib deprecation warnings outside the reg estimation and validation paths.

unverified_areas: Robust, clustered, bootstrap, weighted, categorical, absorbed-effect, and constrained regression are unsupported by the public reg API and are not passed by this audit.
Python-Stata-R agreement is evaluated by the separate three-engine comparison stage; this code audit does not issue that comparison or a final attestation.
The frozen fixture is well-conditioned; broader platform and BLAS variation remains a residual reproducibility risk outside this single macOS arm64 environment.
